title: A Curiously Perfect Circle
statementMd:
You've invented the **Armorstand Circle Placement Constructor (ACPC)**, a command to generate circles in *Minecraft*! Using repeating command blocks, ACPC generates a circle on the ground of a given radius $r$ by first spawning a central armor stand, which then repeatedly spawns another armor stand entity $r$ blocks in front of it and rotates slightly clockwise. The central armor stand then forces all the other armor stands to face inwards, creating the illusion of a circle.

You're planning to use ACPC to generate a circle as part of a house you're designing in a plains biome. You select a $N \times N$ area to place your circle, where $N$ is even, given as a 2D grid. Your circle will be centered at the middle of the grid. Within the grid, certain blocks have tall grass growing on them; you want to use this foliage as part of your design. A block without tall grass is marked as `.`, while a block with tall grass is marked as `#`.

You want to find the **smallest** radius $r$ to use such that the circle **touches** the most blocks with tall grass. Tall grass **touches** the circle if the circumference of the circle intersects or is tangent to the perimeter of that tile. A circle may have a radius of $0$, where it is just a point at the center of the grid. In this case, blocks with perimeters that contain this point are touching the circle. Notably, we're only considering the **distance of the circle's circumference from the central point**, disregarding the base areas of the individual armor stands. Additionally, the circle may extend out of the grid.

Given a $N \times N$ grid where $N$ is even, output the **radius of the smallest circle** centered in the **middle of the grid** with the **circumference that touches the most tall grass**!

## Input

The first line of input is even integer $N$ ($2 \le N \le 500, \space N \text{ is even}$): the length of a side of the square grid. Following this are $N$ lines of length $N$ each: the square grid.

## Output

Output a single floating-point value: the minimum radius of the circle that touches the most tall grass. Your answer will be accepted if it is within an absolute or relative error of $10^{-6}$ to the jury's answer.

## Note

On the first testcase, the maximum possible number of tall grass touched is $8$. The minimum radius of a circle that touches $8$ tall grass tiles is $1$.
statementZhMd:
你发明了 **Armorstand Circle Placement Constructor (ACPC)**，这是一条用于在 *Minecraft* 中生成圆形的命令！ACPC 使用循环命令方块，通过先生成一个位于中心的盔甲架，再让它不断在前方 $r$ 格处生成另一个盔甲架，并略微顺时针旋转，从而在地面上生成半径为 $r$ 的圆。随后，中心的盔甲架会让其他所有盔甲架朝向圆心，营造出一个圆形的视觉效果。

你打算在一片平原生物群系中设计一栋房屋，并使用 ACPC 将圆形作为房屋的一部分。你选定了一个 $N \times N$ 的区域来放置圆形，其中 $N$ 为偶数。该区域以二维网格给出，圆的中心位于网格中央。网格中的某些方块上长有高草，你想把这些植物作为设计的一部分。没有高草的方块标记为 `.`，有高草的方块标记为 `#`。

你想找出最小的半径 $r$，使圆能**接触**到最多的高草方块。如果圆周与某个方块的边界相交或相切，则称该方块上的高草**接触**圆。圆的半径可以为 $0$，此时它只是网格中心的一个点。此时，边界包含该点的方块会接触圆。特别地，我们只考虑圆周到中心点的距离，不考虑各个盔甲架本身占据的底面区域。此外，圆可以延伸到网格之外。

给定一个 $N \times N$ 的网格，其中 $N$ 为偶数，请输出以网格**中央**为圆心、且圆周能接触到最多高草的**最小圆的半径**！

## 输入格式

输入的第一行为偶数 $N$（$2 \le N \le 500, \space N \text{ is even}$）：正方形网格的边长。接下来有 $N$ 行，每行长度为 $N$，表示该正方形网格。

## 输出格式

输出一个浮点数：能接触到最多高草的圆的最小半径。若你的答案与标准答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{-6}$，则会被接受。

## 说明

对于第一个测试用例，圆最多可以接触 $8$ 株高草。能接触到 $8$ 株高草的圆的最小半径为 $1$。
